description: Reads ONE subnet: name, typeIdentifier, netType, every readable attribute, `updatable` (the attribute names tia_subnet_update can change on it, plus Name when it is writable), the connected `nodes` [{device, interface, node, address, subnetMask}] and the `ioSystems` [{name, number, controller, devices}] on it. Read it before tia_subnet_update or tia_subnet_delete: the nodes and IO systems listed (all pages of a paged read) are what a delete would disconnect or remove. An unknown subnet is 404 not_found. Requires a connected project. `inventoryGaps` [{kind, subject, reason}] lists every read that failed while the serve scanned the project (empty when all succeeded); a non-empty list means the nodes and IO systems above may be incomplete. A gap of kind `io_system_subnet` also carries `ioSystem` {number, controller}, the identity the serve decides on (`subject` is only the name). A `subnet_attribute` gap with the subject `<subnet> attribute list` means the attribute LIST could not be read: `updatable: []` is then a gap, not a statement that nothing is writable. A `subnet_attribute` gap with the subject `<subnet>.<attribute>` is one attribute that could not be read (it is absent from `attributes`) and says nothing about `updatable`. Pass limit (1..1000) and each nextCursor as cursor to page: one unit is a node, then one IO-device assignment (an empty IO system is one unit). A system split across pages repeats its header with only that page's devices. total counts these units; inventoryGaps describes the whole scan. If inventoryGaps itself is omitted, a smaller limit cannot shrink it: raise TIA_MCP_MAX_VALUE_CHARS/TIA_MCP_MAX_RESPONSE_CHARS or read the serve directly. Restart without cursor on cursor_stale. Maps to GET /subnets/{subnet}. Read-only (class R).

cursor.description: opaque nextCursor of the previous intact page; omit for the first page

limit.description: page size, 1..1000 node or IO-assignment units

subnet.description: subnet name, as listed by tia_subnets

name: tia_subnet_get
title: TIA — subnet details
